description: This PHP source file defines the ApiAuthorizationSubscriber class, which is an event subscriber that manages API authorization and access control for REST controllers within the OrangeHRM system. It listens to controller execution and exception events to enforce permissions based on user roles and API route parameters.

classes.name: ApiAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that handles API authorization by listening to kernel controller and exception events. It verifies user permissions based on API classes and HTTP methods, throwing forbidden exceptions or returning error responses accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping kernel event constants to class methods for handling controller and exception events, with specified priorities.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Checks controller type and permissions for API requests, throwing ForbiddenException if unauthorized.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles ForbiddenException thrown during API requests to generate a standardized error response.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Private helper method to retrieve the controller instance from the event.

methods.name: getPermissionGetterMethod
methods.description: Returns the method name to check permissions (canRead, canCreate, etc.) based on HTTP method.
